paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Achitai, [Keritot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.13b.13). Rav Shmuel bar Achitai, [Sukkah 42a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.42a.6).[^1]

notes.text: Davidson reads Rav Yehudah bar Achotai in Keritot and Rav Shmuel bar Hattai in Sukkah. The name Achitai expands Hyman’s abbreviation from the heading. Heilprin has entries for [Rav Yehudah](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1714&lang=en) and [Rav Shmuel](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3367&lang=en) and gives Achitai in both headings.
